source_title: Samsung RF263BEAESR spec sheet (Water Filter HAF-CIN / DA29-00020B)
filter_location_text: Samsung support guidance varies by model — consult the user manual for internal filter housing location on French-door models with external water dispensers.
replacement_steps_summary: Samsung support guidance for HAF-CIN filters: turn off water supply, rotate the old filter counterclockwise to unlock and remove, install the new filter clockwise until locked, then flush several gallons and reset the filter indicator.
cautions: Samsung support recommends genuine Samsung water filters only and replacing approximately every six months or when the filter indicator prompts.
notes: Tier 1 Samsung bundle for RF263BEAESR — builder spec lists Accessories Water Filter HAF-CIN; HAF-CIN accessory cartridge DA29-00020B.
